requirement: When a real buyer says 'The mechanism is interesting, but we cannot manufacture it,' the system must produce: OBJECTION → CONSTRAINT → KNOWLEDGE_ATOM → ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT → REDESIGN → NEW_EXPERIMENT → PACKAGE_V2

conversion_pipeline.name: BUYER_OBJECTION_CAPTURED
conversion_pipeline.input: CEO fills BUYER_RESPONSE_LOOP_TEMPLATE (R352) with buyer's objection
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Parse objection text → classify objection type (technical/commercial/manufacturing/regulatory)

conversion_pipeline.name: OBJECTION_TO_CONSTRAINT
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Convert objection to structured constraint: {constraint_type, constraint_description, affected_package, severity}
conversion_pipeline.example: 'Cannot manufacture at scale' → {type: MANUFACTURING, description: 'Buyer cannot produce mechanism at scale', severity: HIGH}

conversion_pipeline.name: CONSTRAINT_TO_KNOWLEDGE_ATOM
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Create KA: KA-BUYER-{package}-{date} with lesson learned
conversion_pipeline.example: KA-BUYER-P-16-001: 'Buyer X indicated manufacturing concern about GaAs PV integration. Future optical power packages must include manufacturing feasibility assessment.'

conversion_pipeline.name: KNOWLEDGE_ATOM_TO_ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Generate engineering requirement: {requirement_id, requirement, metric, threshold, affected_candidate}
conversion_pipeline.example: REQ-P-16-MFG-002: 'Manufacturing feasibility study for GaAs PV integration. Metric: MRL >= 4.'

conversion_pipeline.name: REQUIREMENT_TO_REDESIGN
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: If requirement cannot be met by current mechanism → trigger repair candidate generation (R364 pattern)

conversion_pipeline.name: REDESIGN_TO_NEW_EXPERIMENT
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Define new validation experiment for the redesigned mechanism

conversion_pipeline.name: PACKAGE_V2
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: Regenerate buyer package with: (1) buyer objection addressed, (2) manufacturing feasibility added, (3) new validation protocol
conversion_pipeline.note: Package V2 is STRONGER than V1 because it addresses a REAL buyer concern.

conversion_pipeline.name: DISCOVERY_CONSTRAINT_INHERITANCE
conversion_pipeline.machine_action: KA feeds into discovery engine — future candidates with similar mechanism must address this manufacturing concern before admission

current_state: PIPELINE BUILT. 0 real buyer feedback processed. Template ready (R352). Conversion logic defined. The engine activates when CEO records first real buyer feedback.
causal_requirement: Buyer feedback must CAUSALLY affect the next action. Not just saved — it must change what the machine does next.
